baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled judgment noun, the active seeking verb, the named age of ignorance, and the closing certainty clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative places a historically identified order and God's order in direct adjudicative comparison. Active seeking makes the contrast an intentional choice of forum or standard, while certainty names the settled knowledge by which the superiority can be recognized.

activation_trace.role: The people-facing adjudication branch supplies the common function of both contrasted judgments and makes their repeated comparison juridical.
The historical-age branch supplies the named rival regime and keeps the ordinary temporal reading present.
The active quest branch makes the rival judgment something deliberately pursued rather than passively inherited.
The good-versus-ugly valuation branch turns the second question into a qualitative test of the two standards.
The settled-knowledge branch supplies the stable epistemic posture able to recognize the better judgment.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply asks whether they prefer pre-Islamic law to God's law.
changed_reading.after: The doubled judgment root and active quest expose deliberate forum choice: a known rival regime is being sought despite a superior divine standard recognizable by settled knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first judgment noun is juxtaposed with ignorance and transgressive seeking.
baseline_models.mechanism: One branch of judgment blocks and turns back harm for the sake of repair. Against it, ignorance can be a loss of forbearance and an agitated temperament, while seeking can shade into overrunning a limit. The contrast can therefore concern rival ways of governing impulse, not information alone.

activation_trace.role: The preventive and corrective restraint branch supplies judgment's capacity to stop harm and redirect conduct.
The loss-of-forbearance branch supplies volatile social temperament as the rival order's operating condition.
The movement-after-stillness branch adds an image of agitation that judgment must govern.
The boundary-crossing branch makes the quest itself capable of participating in the disorder it seeks to authorize.

changed_reading.before: Ignorance means only deficient knowledge or a past era.
changed_reading.after: It can also name a volatile social operating mode that lets impulse overrun limits, whereas better judgment restrains harm and redirects conduct toward repair.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The better judgment is explicitly related to a people characterized by certainty.
baseline_models.mechanism: Judgment can be something made firm and reliable, goodness can be beneficent excellence, and a people can be imagined through maintaining and supporting what lets a collective stand. Certainty supplies the fixed epistemic base for that durable order.

activation_trace.role: The firm construction branch supplies judgment as a reliably made normative structure rather than a momentary verdict.
The excellent and beneficent action branch makes better judgment effective good, not merely comparative prestige.
The care and maintenance branch lets the addressed people appear as a collective sustained by responsible governance.
The supporting-framework branch supplies the social order by which communal life remains standing.
The removal-of-doubt branch supplies the fixed knowledge on which the communal structure can rest.

changed_reading.before: God gives the best isolated verdict.
changed_reading.after: God's judgment is the better-built normative support through which a certainty-bearing community can be maintained and kept standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction asks what judgment they seek and then names God as the unsurpassed source of judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The arbitration branch of judgment shifts attention from the content of a rule to the authorization of a judge. Active seeking then becomes a search for the authority to whom the dispute or command will be handed.

activation_trace.role: The delegation and arbitration branch supplies the act of installing an authority whose determination will govern the parties.
The quest branch turns authorization into a purposeful search for an arbiter.
The worship-and-worshipped branch keeps ultimate arbitration tied to the authority acknowledged in devotion.

changed_reading.before: The only issue is which rulebook contains the better rule.
changed_reading.after: The question also asks whom they are deliberately installing as arbiter and whether delegated authority is being detached from the God they acknowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first contextual movement shows a self making killing easy, then converts that event into an obligatory protection of life, names social corruption, supplies deterrent sanction, and immediately preserves repentance and repair. This sequence strengthens the preventive branch of judgment: sound rule interrupts the conversion of inner volatility into normalized violence and still makes restoration possible.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies restraint and corrective redirection as the function now activated by the violence sequence.
The self-facilitation branch supplies the dangerous easing by which an inward impulse becomes executable harm.
The force-and-disposition branch locates the pressure toward violence within the agent's own governing temperament.
The life-ending branch supplies the concrete harm that preventive judgment must stop rather than merely classify afterward.
The binding-inscription branch turns the singular killing into an obligatory general norm protecting life.
The loss-of-sound-order branch expands private violence into the public disorder that judgment must contain.
The exemplary-deterrence branch supplies a sanction designed to block repetition beyond the immediate offender.
The restoration-against-corruption branch prevents restraint from collapsing into punishment alone and completes it with repair.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from threatened killing to actual killing, then to a universalized life norm and public-corruption frame.
The theft sanction is followed immediately by repentance and repair, joining deterrence to restoration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-facilitated killing, a binding life norm, public corruption, deterrence, and repair; I infer that the restraint branch of judgment is the arrow that interrupts this escalation. A live alternative is that the sequence defines retribution only, without making prevention the controlling function of the focus verse.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts two abstract legal standards.
changed_reading.after: It also asks whether they seek an order that lets agitated desire become normalized violence, instead of a divine judgment that restrains harm, deters repetition, and reopens repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Selective listening, displacement of words, conditional acceptance of a desired ruling, illicit gain, and turning away after requesting arbitration make the focus verb of seeking sharply procedural. The rival judgment is generated by shopping for a forum that will ratify a prior appetite, whereas just adjudication remains outcome-independent.

activation_trace.role: The focus quest branch becomes a directed search for a favorable venue under the contextual pressure.
The focus arbitration branch supplies the authority being conditionally solicited and then rejected.
The falsehood branch supplies corrupted intake, so the forum begins from preferred misinformation rather than open evidence.
The deviation-from-direction branch supplies textual displacement as a mechanism for bending the applicable standard.
The taking branch supplies conditional uptake of the ruling only when the preselected result is offered.
The illicit and defective gain branch supplies a material incentive for outcome-shaped judgment.
The justice branch supplies the outcome-independent counterstandard required of the requested adjudication.
The contextual arbitration branch makes the act of installing an arbiter explicit while an existing judgment remains at hand.
The turning-away branch completes the forum-shopping cycle when the available judgment does not secure the desired end.

structural_cues: The conditional instruction to take one offered result and beware its absence precedes the invitation to adjudication.
The sequence asks why arbitration is requested while an acknowledged judgment is already present, then records withdrawal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false intake, textual displacement, conditional uptake, illicit gain, requested arbitration, and withdrawal; I infer the arrow of strategic forum shopping toward a predetermined outcome. A live alternative is ordinary inconsistency or fear rather than a coordinated search for a favorable forum.

changed_reading.before: They seek a clearly identified rival code in a single direct choice.
changed_reading.after: They can manufacture the judgment of ignorance procedurally by filtering evidence, bending the standard, soliciting arbiters conditionally, and leaving when the result is not favorable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The judgment sequence is institutional rather than merely oracular: a straight measure governs adjudication, custodians preserve a received book, witnesses answer for it, injury is matched proportionally, a claim may be remitted, and later revelation confirms what precedes it. Better judgment is thus a publicly accountable chain of preservation, proportion, and truthful continuity.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies firmness and reliability as the quality the institutional chain must preserve.
The straight-balance branch supplies calibrated proportionality as the operative shape of judging.
The adjudication branch places judgment in an enacted practice carried by successive responsible agents.
The guarding branch supplies custody of the standard against loss or manipulation.
The knowledgeable-testimony branch makes custodians answerable to what they can publicly attest.
The equivalence-of-injury branch supplies measured correspondence rather than unbounded retaliation.
The charitable-right branch supplies voluntary remission, showing that calibrated judgment can preserve a path beyond exacting the claim.
The completion-and-stability branch supplies truthful confirmation across successive disclosures.

structural_cues: Repeated commands and reports of judging are distributed across prophets, learned custodians, witnesses, and communities.
Proportional redress is paired with voluntary remission, while later disclosure confirms rather than erases the earlier standard.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies just measure, custody, testimony, proportional redress, remission, and confirmation; I infer that their ordered combination defines an accountable transmission mechanism for judgment. A live alternative is that these are separate obligations of prior communities rather than a single mechanism qualifying the focus claim.

changed_reading.before: The superiority of God's judgment is only the superiority of its source.
changed_reading.after: Its superiority is also enacted as an entrusted and witnessable practice that preserves the standard, measures injury, permits remission, and maintains truthful continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, truth and guarding establish a criterion, distinct prescribed paths are allowed to function as a test, and competition in good remains possible. The prohibited mechanism is instead following appetite and being deflected from part of what was disclosed. The judgment of ignorance is therefore not identical with every legal difference; it is the desire-led fragmentation of a guarded standard.

activation_trace.role: The focus firmness branch supplies the intact standard whose internal coherence is threatened by selective removal.
The lack-of-knowledge branch marks the result when desire displaces a disclosed and guarded criterion.
The boundary-crossing branch supplies the active move from legitimate path difference into appetite-led violation of the criterion.
The reality-matching branch supplies the disclosed criterion against which judgment and deviation can be distinguished.
The witnessing-and-guarding branch supplies oversight that keeps the criterion available and inspectable.
The contextual adjudication branch directly binds the guarded criterion to the act of judging.
The following-after branch supplies the directional dependency by which judgment can be led away from its criterion.
The inward-inclination branch supplies appetite as the competing guide that redirects judgment.
The entering-an-undertaking branch supplies a prescribed communal course that can differ without becoming ungoverned appetite.
The visibly clear road branch supplies intelligible direction within legitimate path plurality.
The test-that-manifests-condition branch makes differentiated paths a site of disclosed conduct rather than an excuse for arbitrary judgment.
The turning-away-from-truth branch supplies the corrupting force exerted on the judge.
The partition branch makes partial subtraction, not only wholesale replacement, a live mechanism of ignorant judgment.

structural_cues: Commands to judge and not follow desires are repeated across 5:48-49 immediately before the focus question.
Legitimate differentiated paths and testing coexist with a warning against diversion from only part of what was disclosed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a truth-matching guarded criterion, differentiated paths, testing, appetite, and partial diversion; I infer that legal plurality itself is not the target, while desire-guided fragmentation is. A live alternative is that the focus still contrasts one complete rival code with divine law and that partial diversion is only a preliminary tactic.

changed_reading.before: The focus opposes one divine law to every nonidentical legal path.
changed_reading.after: The sharper contrast is guarded, test-bearing path plurality versus appetite-led selection that removes or bends part of the disclosed criterion and then calls the result judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, repeated patronage language is driven by diseased hearts fearing a reversal of fortune; an opening or decision exposes concealed commitments, failed works collapse, and the sequence ends by identifying a different protecting authority and a prevailing party. This retroactively links choice of arbiter to the protective coalition under which one places oneself.

activation_trace.role: The focus delegation branch supplies jurisdiction as authority handed to a chosen protector or arbiter.
The focus certainty branch supplies the stable opposite of authority-switching driven by anticipated danger.
The taking-charge branch supplies protective governance as a relationship people deliberately enter.
The departure-from-balance branch locates unstable alliance choice in a disordered inner condition.
The feared-defeat branch supplies the anticipated reversal that motivates protective jurisdiction shopping.
The decisive-settlement branch supplies an opening that can function as a judgment exposing which authority was reliable.
The inward-concealment branch supplies hidden allegiance that the decisive turn brings into view.
The collapse branch supplies the failure of works built on the wrong protective calculation.
The taking-charge branch identifies the counter-jurisdiction in explicit protective terms.
The organized-party branch turns patronage into a visible collective alignment around authority.
The overcoming-force branch supplies the eventual outcome by which fearful calculations of protection are reversed.

structural_cues: The focus is followed immediately by repeated prohibitions and affirmations concerning protective authority.
Fear of a reversal motivates rushed allegiance, while a decisive opening exposes secrecy and the unit closes with the prevailing party.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated patronage, fear of reversal, decisive disclosure, collapsed works, and a prevailing authority-group; I infer that protective allegiance carries jurisdictional consequences for whom one accepts as arbiter. A live alternative is that social alliance and legal judgment remain parallel concerns without a direct authority-transfer between them.

changed_reading.before: Seeking judgment is an intellectual comparison detached from social risk.
changed_reading.after: It can be a fear-driven transfer of jurisdiction to the coalition expected to protect and prevail; certainty is the refusal to switch arbiters with every anticipated turn of fortune.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a material animal-control branch rather than the ordinary legal branch of judgment. It remains anchored in the focus through judgment, agitation, communal standing, and fixed certainty, but downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory image-level analogy, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The judgment noun is set against an agitated ignorance and addressed to a people marked by settled certainty.

activation_trace.role: The enclosing bridle branch supplies a material mechanism that checks runaway motion and makes directed movement possible.
The agitation-after-stillness branch supplies the unstable motion requiring governance.
The bodily-standing branch supplies the regained upright posture of a collective whose motion is governed.
The fixed-knowledge branch supplies steadiness in place of restless and reactive motion.

changed_reading.before: Judgment is only an abstract verdict pronounced over a community.
changed_reading.after: At the level of material analogy, the question asks whether an agitated collective wants unbridled motion, while God's better judgment checks that motion so the people can stand and move with settled direction.

strongest_changes: The violence sequence turns judgment into preventive and reparative restraint, not punishment alone.
The selective-hearing sequence turns seeking into procedural forum shopping for a predetermined outcome.
The immediate pre-focus sequence distinguishes legitimate tested path plurality from appetite-led partial fragmentation of a guarded standard.
The post-focus patronage sequence makes fear-driven allegiance a possible mechanism for transferring jurisdiction.
summary.what_was_special: The four contextual movements did not collapse into one generic legal contrast. They activated restraint after violence, accountable custody and witness, guarded plurality under testing, and patronage-based jurisdiction, while the bridle image remained live only under explicit exploratory containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The restraint branch may illuminate the function of judgment without controlling the noun's primary sense here.
The post-focus patronage language may concern social alliance without implying a full transfer of legal jurisdiction.
Partial diversion may be one tactic within a complete rival code rather than the defining form of the judgment of ignorance.
